_comment: Wire ABI for sandbox::* error codes. Pinned by wire_parity.rs (iii-sandbox-contract) and consumed by SDK contract tests in Node + Python. Adding a new SandboxError variant requires adding a row here. Changing a `code` is a breaking SDK change.

codes.summary: request payload failed validation (e.g. missing/malformed sandbox_id)
sandbox uuid not found in registry
sandbox is at its exec concurrency cap (max_concurrent_exec_per_sandbox, default 4); a slot frees when any in-flight exec finishes, but detach foreground processes rather than waiting on them
sandbox already stopped; create a new one
image not in catalog or allowlist
rootfs missing on disk; enable auto_install or pre-provision cache
auto-install pull/extract failed; retry
exec exceeded timeout_ms
fs op rejected by supervisor as invalid
path does not exist
path is wrong type (file vs dir)
path already exists
directory is not empty
permission denied
generic fs I/O failure
invalid regex/pattern in grep or sed
fs streaming channel aborted mid-flight; retry
fs op unsupported by this supervisor; upgrade the sandbox adapter
VM boot or supervisor session failure
AdapterUnavailable: the sandbox adapter is not connected; retry once it is up
ContractMismatch: the adapter implements a different contract major version than the engine
NoAdapterConfigured: this engine has no sandbox adapter; set sandbox.adapter in its engine config
OperationUnsupported: the adapter does not implement this operation
resource limit exceeded (cpu/memory/concurrency cap)
SourceRejected: bad manifest, or host_path outside the allowed roots
StateBusy: a VM already holds this state key; fix carries the live vm_id and instance
InstanceMismatch: the request names a different instance than the live VM; fix carries the live vm_id and instance
VmNotFound: no VM with this vm_id
Unauthorized: the request auth token does not match
PrepareFailed: worker::prepare failed; retry
